changelog:
Initial public release of the Publisher skill.

- Publish HTML frontend projects to the PushWebly platform.
- List published projects and obtain shareable URLs.
- Toggle project visibility between public/private and manage passwords.
- Package published HTML projects into Android APKs.
- Strict, stepwise publish flow with clear prompts and update notification protocol.
- Supports both remote API calls via HTTP/curl and local MCP tools if mounted.
- Login and registration processes are built in.
